title: Reading a production monitoring export
titleZh: 判讀生產監測匯出報表
passage:
DOCUMENT 1 — HEMLOCK INSTRUMENTS | Shift export guide

The first field gives the number of alert messages received while the connection was confirmed. A zero means the receiver was connected and did not receive an alert during that checked interval. A dash means there is no confirmed connection for that interval. It does not mean the device sent nothing.

Report the duration of missing coverage separately. If a row covers only the connected part of a longer job, neither a zero nor a positive count proves what happened outside the confirmed interval. Do not estimate a missing count by copying from a neighbouring row.

DOCUMENT 2 — SHIFT LOG | Tuesday, Line 4

09:00–09:30 | Receiver connected throughout; count 2.
09:30–10:00 | No confirmed connection recorded; count —.
10:00–10:20 | Receiver connected throughout; count 0.

Job Fern ran from 09:40 to 10:20. No other receiver covered the line during the unconfirmed period. For jobs that extend across an unconfirmed interval, the export creates one covered row and a separate note about unavailable coverage.

DOCUMENT 3 — MESSAGE FROM QUALITY OPERATIONS | Wednesday morning

The first draft of the customer summary says “Job Fern: no alerts during the run.” Replace that sentence. State the period we actually checked and what the receiver got during that period. Name the earlier portion of the job as unconfirmed rather than filling in a number.

For our internal investigation, keep the earlier export untouched so we can compare it with a new one if a supervisor finds additional source logs. Please send me a revised customer summary today, but do not attach the internal shift log to it.
passageZh:
文件一 — 鐵杉儀器｜班次報表匯出指南

第一個欄位記錄的是連線確認期間收到的警示訊息數。零表示在這段確認期間，接收器一直連線且未收到警示。破折號則表示無法確認這段期間有連線，不表示裝置未送出任何警示。

請另行報告缺少監測資料的時長。若某列只涵蓋一項較長工作的已確認連線部分，欄位不論是零或正數，都不能證明確認區間之外發生了什麼。請勿用相鄰資料列的數字來估填缺少的計數。

文件二 — 班次日誌｜週二，第 4 線

09:00–09:30｜接收器全程連線；警示數 2。
09:30–10:00｜無已確認連線的紀錄；警示數 —。
10:00–10:20｜接收器全程連線；警示數 0。

Fern 工作從 09:40 執行到 10:20。在連線未經確認的這段期間，沒有其他接收器監測該線。若工作的執行時間跨越連線未確認區間，匯出報表會為有資料的區間產生一列，並在附註另列無法確認的監測範圍。

文件三 — 品質作業部訊息｜週三上午

客戶摘要的第一版寫著「Fern 工作：整個執行期間沒有警示」。請替換這句話，寫出我們實際檢查的區間，以及這段期間接收器收到了什麼。請把工作較早的那一段標為「連線未確認」，而不填入一個數字。

為利內部調查，請讓較早的匯出報表維持原樣；若主管找到更多來源日誌，我們才能拿先前的匯出報表與新報表比對。請今天把修改後的客戶摘要送給我，但不要把內部班次日誌當成附件。
